# Kimi K3 Swarm Workstation

> Native Windows and Mac desktop app that coordinates up to 300 parallel AI sub-agents powered by Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 — the world's largest open-weight model at 2.8 trillion parameters, released July 16, 2026 (open weights July 27), with a 1-million-token context window and native vision. Built on the official K3 Swarm Max orchestrator variant. The swarm fans out to research, code, scrape, analyze, and see in parallel, finishing in minutes what single-agent models take hours to do. Kimi K3 is ranked #1 in the world for web-interface building and beats Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 across Moonshot's evaluation suite. Features Hyper-Parallel Browser, MCP Hive, Swarm Bridge (drops into Claude Code/Cursor/OpenClaw), Swarm Vision, ThoughtStream live reasoning, Data Fusion Engine, and Custom Agent Tuning. Free Swarm tier for the first 1,000 users (lifetime), +50% bonus credits through August 11, referral swarm-cap boosts, and founding early-access to the July 27 open weights. One-click signed installer.

## Model: Kimi K3

- **Developer:** Moonshot AI, released July 16, 2026 (open weights July 27, 2026)
- **Scale:** 2.8 trillion parameters — largest open-weight model in the world (vs DeepSeek V4 Pro 1.6T)
- **Architecture:** Sparse MoE, 16 of 896 experts active; Kimi Delta Attention (KDA, hybrid linear attention, up to 6.3× faster decoding at 1M context); Attention Residuals (AttnRes, +25% training efficiency); Stable LatentMoE; Quantile Balancing; Per-Head Muon
- **Context:** 1,000,000 tokens
- **Vision:** native visual understanding built in
- **Reasoning:** always-on thinking mode
- **Variants:** K3 Max (chat, coding, agent) and K3 Swarm Max (orchestrator with sub-agents for deep research / parallel processing)
- **Benchmark position (Moonshot-reported):** #1 on Arena for web-interface building, beats Claude Opus 4.8 max and GPT-5.5 high across Moonshot's suite; strong on GPU kernel optimization
- **Availability:** Kimi website, app, Kimi Code, API now; open weights July 27
- **Promo:** 10–50% bonus credits on API top-ups through August 11

## Swarm Features (desktop build)

- **Hyper-Parallel Browser:** 300 agents crawl simultaneously, isolated contexts, gathering from Amazon/Reddit/LinkedIn/GitHub at once
- **MCP Hive:** every agent carries a full MCP toolset, multiplying K3's tool use across the swarm
- **Swarm Bridge:** Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible API lets the swarm back Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenClaw at a fraction of frontier cost
- **Swarm Vision:** K3 native vision lets all 300 agents analyze screenshots, charts, interfaces
- **ThoughtStream:** live visualization of all agents' always-on reasoning
- **Data Fusion Engine:** auto-compiles findings into PDF/Excel/JSON with proofs and links
- **Custom Agent Tuning:** assign roles to agent groups
- **PARL:** parallel coordination layer preventing agent collisions
- **Critical-Steps routing:** floods compute to hard task nodes, cuts runtime up to 80%

## Use Cases

- Development: 300 agents sweep whole repo for bugs in parallel
- Frontend: K3's #1 web-building skill parallelized across agents
- Research: hundreds of sources scanned and cross-checked, sourced 50-page brief
- Marketing: 100+ competitor campaigns analyzed simultaneously
- Investing: financials of 50 companies pulled in parallel into one table
- Agent backend: drive Claude Code / Cursor through the Bridge at low cost

## Pricing Model

- App: Free
- Swarm mode: free via proxy pool; first 1,000 users free-for-life

- No subscription, no telemetry

## Platform and Distribution

- **Windows:** 10 and 11, 64-bit, signed .exe; RTX 30xx+ optional for acceleration
- **macOS:** 12+, Apple Developer ID signed and notarized, native M1–M5
- **Model execution:** cloud now; local build available after July 27 open-weights drop
- **Distribution:** GitHub releases, SHA-256 checksums published

## Privacy and Security Model

- Sandboxed app, isolated local browser engine — task data not retained on Moonshot servers
- Signed installers, published checksums
- Optional BYO key stored locally
- Open source client, auditable on GitHub

## Target Audience

- Developers wanting parallel whole-repo work and agentic execution
- Frontend developers leveraging K3's #1 web-building rank
- Researchers needing large-scale parallel gathering with native vision
- Marketers and investors doing bulk parallel analysis
- Claude Code / Cursor / OpenClaw users wanting a cheaper frontier-class agentic backend
- Teams wanting swarm orchestration without CLI complexity

## Comparable Tools

- **Kimi Code (official)** — Moonshot's official K3 access, single-agent default
- **Kilo Code, Cline** — IDE extensions supporting Kimi models
- **OpenClaw** — autonomous agent, can use K3 as backend
- **Cursor / Windsurf** — single-agent IDE assistants
- **Claude Code (Opus 4.8), GPT-5.5** — single-agent frontier tools, higher cost

This app combines the world's largest open model (2.8T), 300-agent parallel swarm, native vision across all agents, 1M context per agent, and Swarm Bridge into existing tools — a combination no existing Kimi tool offers.

**Is it safe?** Sandboxed, signed, checksummed, isolated browser engine.

**How is K3 different?** Largest open model ever — 2.8T params, 1M context, native vision, Kimi Delta Attention (6.3× faster long-context). Every advantage multiplies across 300 agents.
